## Reporting rules — How do we handle missing values, unknown times, set counts and activity durations? {#reporting-rules-how-do-we-handle-missing-values-unknown-times-set-counts-and-activity-durations}

Agree the meaning and calculation of reported values, including unknown times, set counts and activity durations.

Keep field-specific decisions in the sheet reviews.

## Transform one trip

The transformation receives one trip's dataset and the reference data required for its target ROS form.

It builds named ROS sheet tables using the target form model's fields and relationships.

Create the ROS trip identifier once, retain its correspondence to the ObServe trip ID, and reuse it across sheets.

O-INFO contains one row for this trip. Set and catch sheets contain the corresponding child records.

Preserve the difference between missing information and a recorded zero or false value.

Resolve source meaning before implementing counts, durations, aggregation or specimen construction.
